scope: Theorem 2.11 (Near-Cauchy large values) of the manuscript “Endpoint pointwise convergence for the Schrodinger equation in higher dimensions” (preprints/Endpoint-pointwise-convergence-for-the-Schrodinger-equation-in-higher-dimensions-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f859efa28f227ff), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V = P T fT be a band-limited field of scale N, and let B2 = P T s2 T wT . Suppose a finite set Y of unit cubes has witnesses zQ ∈ Q such that B(zQ) ≤ 1, |V (zQ)| ≥ Nk/2 /R, R ≥ 1. Then, for every ε > 0, |Y | ≤ CεRqk+ε X T s2 T . (2.26) The conclusion holds with unit suprema and fixed enlargements of the witness cubes. The Fourier enlargement and original decay orders can be fixed before ε is chosen.
